title: cxz settings
description: Local cxz client preferences. Comments and trailing commas are supported. Host file mappings and Docker settings are applied on the Linux daemon host.

$schema.description: Editor schema reference. cxz edit refreshes settings.schema.json from the current binary.

connections.description: Named connections shown together in the project view. Changes apply when the TUI next starts. Omit to use the local installation on Linux.

default.description: Name of the connection to focus initially. Must refer to a configured connection. Empty or omitted selects the alphabetically first connection.

agent.description: Legacy global preference. New sessions use the agent belonging to the selected account.

files.description: Copy host files or directories into agent sessions before startup. Edit and publish these mappings on the Linux daemon host.

src.description: Host file or directory to copy. Supports ~/; relative paths use the host CLI working directory.

dst.description: Absolute container path, or a path starting with ${AGENT_CONFIG_DIR}, ${SESSION_HOME}, or ${WORKSPACE}. Use forward slashes; parent traversal (..) and / itself are not allowed.

agent.description: Apply to this agent only. Empty or omitted applies to both agents.

devcontainer.description: Project container settings, published by the Linux host CLI. Compose overrides apply to new or explicitly recreated Compose-based devcontainers.

compose.description: Optional path to the project Compose override. Defaults to docker-compose.yaml beside settings.jsonc; edit with cxz edit docker-compose. Relative paths use this settings directory; absolute, ~/ and ${HOME} paths work. The file may include other local Compose files.

docker.description: Shared Docker engine settings. Edit these on the Linux daemon host; Windows only saves them locally.

mode.description: dind enables the shared engine; off disables it. Empty or omitted uses dind.

image.description: Docker-in-Docker image. Empty or omitted uses docker:29-dind.

compose.description: Optional Compose override containing only services.dind. Relative paths use this settings directory; absolute and ~/ paths are also supported.

model.description: Default model ID or alias for new sessions. Empty or omitted keeps the provider default. Maximum 200 bytes; no whitespace, control characters, or leading hyphen.

target.description: ssh://[user@]host[:port] uses SSH config aliases and needs no expose relay. tcp://host:port needs cxz expose and token_file. local:// discovers a local Linux installation; unix:///path uses a direct socket. ${STATE} expands to this client's state directory.

token_file.description: Required for TCP only. Path to the token file, never the token itself. Relative paths use the client state directory; ${STATE} is supported.
